title: Harder to Defend: Towards Chinese Toxicity Attacks via Implicit Enhancement and Obfuscation Rewriting

bias_targets.methodology: Grouping original harmful texts into fine-grained intent categories (including 'Discrimination' and 'Stereotype') and calculating the attack success rate (ASR) of LLM-as-judge detectors on implicitly toxic and obfuscated rewrites generated from these texts.

Evaluating implicit toxicity detectors using the SWSR dataset (a Chinese dataset for online sexism detection) and conducting qualitative case analyses on generated implicit toxic responses related to gender discrimination scenarios, such as female graduates facing biases during job searches.
